references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the same ritual is described for the waving of the guilt offering lamb and oil before the Lord, but for one who can afford the full offering.
The introduction to the regulations for the poor leper who cannot afford the full offering, where the waving of the guilt offering lamb is mentioned.
Describes the wave offering (tenufa) that the priest was to perform before the Lord, the same ritual action as in Leviticus 14:24.
Basic regulations concerning the guilt offering (asham) mentioned in the verse.
Moses is instructed to wave the offering as a wave offering before the Lord, the same ritual practice.
Describes the wave offering before the Lord, using the same terminology and ritual action.
